title: Getting started with PP
text: type selects estimator: "mle": maximum likelihood. Persons answers lowest highest category get -Inf/Inf. Items person answer left : \(L\) answered items leave-one-estimates \(\hat\theta_{(-j)}\), pseudovalues \(L\hat\theta - (L-1)\hat\theta_{(-j)}\). jackknife estimate mean, median AMT (cmeth), standard error \(\sqrt{\sum_j (ps_j - \bar{ps})^2 / (L(L-1))}\) (Wainer & Wright, 1980). leave-one-sample may finite estimate, e.g. type = "mle" wrong answer left . samples (samples bound range converged) left person's jackknife, counted column excluded, warning given; WLE avoids cases. person whose full estimate solution (status "extreme", "no_response", "boundary" "not_converged" estobj$estimates) fewer two usable leave-one-samples (status "too_few_items") gets NA. version 0.6.4 standard error mixed leave-one-estimates formula pseudovalues small factor \(L-1\), items counted answered, leave-one-samples without finite estimate dropped silently. AMT-robustified jackknife: choosing cmeth = "AMT", pseudovalues combined scheme 4 Wainer & Wright (1980): split pseudovalues right wrong answers (polytomous items: answers expected score \(\hat\theta\) ), group summarised Andrews' sine M-estimator (AMT), one winners Princeton Robustness Study (Andrews et al., 1972), two values averaged group sizes weights. text: statistics computed estimate \(\hat\theta\) person, items person answered (missing responses left every sum). observed response \(x_i\), expected score \(E_i\), variance \(V_i\) fourth central moment \(C_i\) item \(\), residual \(Y_i = x_i - E_i\), \(n\) answered items: infit (weighted mean square, Wright & Masters, 1982): \(\sum Y_i^2 / \sum V_i\), variance \(q^2 = \sum (C_i - V_i^2) / (\sum V_i)^2\). outfit (unweighted mean square): \(\sum (Y_i^2 / V_i) / n\), variance \(q^2 = \sum (C_i / V_i^2) / n^2 - 1/n\). mean squares \(MS\) standardised Wilson-Hilferty transformation \(t = (MS^{1/3} - 1) (3/q) + q/3\). chisq \(\sum Y_i^2 / V_i\) df \(= n - 1\) p-value \(\chi^2\) distribution. lz (Drasgow, Levine & Williams, 1985): log-likelihood \(l_0 = \sum \log P_i(x_i)\), standardised expectation variance model, \((l_0 - \sum E \log P_i) / \sqrt{\sum Var \log P_i}\). lz_unst \(l_0 / n\). lz* (Snijders, 2001) corrects lz estimated \(\theta\): item information \(\), \(c_n = \sum Cov(\log P_i, s_i) / \) (\(s_i\) score item \(\)) term \(r_0\) estimating equation (mle: 0, wle: \(J / (2I)\), map: \((\mu - \theta) / \sigma^2\)), lz* \(= (l_0 - \sum E \log P_i + c_n r_0) / \sqrt{\sum Var \log P_i - c_n^2 }\). dichotomous items Snijders' lz*, polytomous items mixed tests generalisation Sinharay (2016). Person fit needs estimate type "mle", "wle" "map". Persons without estimate (status "ok" pp$estimates, e.g. extreme score mle) get NA. single answered dichotomous item lz* defined (corrected variance 0) \(\chi^2\) p-value degree freedom; NA. SE = TRUE every statistic gets jackknife standard error: answered item \(j\), \(\theta\) estimated without item \(j\) (leave-one-estimates JKpp()) statistic \(f_{(-j)}\) computed remaining items. \(L\) answered items \(m\) leave-one-samples finite estimate, \(SE = (L - 1) \sqrt{\sum_j (f_{(-j)} - \bar f)^2 / (m (m - 1))}\), \(\sqrt{(L-1)/L \sum_j (f_{(-j)} - \bar f)^2}\) sample left (Efron & Stein, 1981). version 0.6.4, lz* summed items also persons missing responses, GPCM infit outfit used observed instead possible categories ignored slopes, mixed tests supported, jackknife standard error lz used prior SD variance, results rounded. responses passed first argument respm; since 1.0.0 taken pp, respm gone: call Pfit(res) instead Pfit(respm = X, pp = res).

title: Plots of person estimates and person fit — pp-plots
text: Person fit map (= "fit"): person fit statistic index estimate, one point per person status "ok". dashed lines critical values \(\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\); persons beyond flagged (rule summary() PPass result), 10 extreme ones labelled. Measurement precision (= "precision"): upper panel shows distribution estimates, lower panel standard error person estimate. item parameters known, standard error whole test follows test information \((\theta)\), sum item informations: \(1/\sqrt{(\theta)}\), \(1/\sqrt{(\theta) + 1/\sigma^2}\) MAP EAP estimates prior variance \(\sigma^2\). curve drawn every person answered every item (curve = NULL); incomplete adaptive designs person set items, curve items holds nobody. ticks bottom mark location item, ability gives information (1PL 2PL difficulty). plot shows test measures accurately whether persons located . robust estimates curve model standard error without Huber weights; EAP estimates standard error posterior SD. Person profile (= "profile"): one panel per person person. answered item point: expected score estimate (x axis, relative maximum score item, easy items left) observed score (y axis, relative maximum score). Responses line model lie close diagonal. Items standardised residual \(|z| = |x - E|/\sqrt{V}\) \(z_{1-\alpha/2}\) marked unexpected labelled item name: wrong answer easy item bottom left, right answer hard item top right. profile shows responses make person conspicuous. panel title gives estimate, standard error fit statistic index. plots drawn tinyplot package, theme set tinyplot::tinytheme() applies .

title: PP 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-14 PP 1.0.0 rebuilds numerical core. Every estimate now checked independent reference implementations. ordinary data (complete responses, extreme scores) MLE, WLE, MAP EAP estimates 0.6.4-1 reproduced (differences 0.001, within convergence criterion exac; robust estimates differ 0.005). Results change places listed : standard errors MAP robust estimates, jackknife, plausible values, person fit, edge cases missing responses, extreme scores 3PL. Function argument names unchanged unless stated.

title: PP 1.0.0
text: Jackknife (JKpp()): standard error now follows textbook formula pseudovalues; larger (factor L − 1, L = number items) comparable MLE/WLE standard error. jackknife runs answered items (: items), leave-one-samples without finite estimate counted new column excluded warning, EAP jackknife works mixed tests. AMT jackknife (cmeth = "AMT"): now AMT-robustified jackknife Wainer & Wright (1980): Andrews’ sine estimator (c = 2.1, MAD scale), applied pseudovalues right wrong answers separately averaged group sizes weights. MAP standard errors now include prior. Robust estimates: standard error sandwich form Huber weights, estimate solves weighted estimating equation accuracy exac (3e-3 ). WLE/MLE 3PL: estimator now safeguarded Newton method per person. Persons iteration oscillated without converging now estimated flagged status. Plausible values (PV()) drawn posterior grid (approx = FALSE) normal distribution mean SD (approx = TRUE, default). use prior person work missing responses. Metropolis-Hastings sampler gone, arguments thinning, burnin mult ignored warning. EAP estimates computed adaptive grid log-likelihoods, also works long tests (products probabilities underflowed ). Person fit (Pfit()): lz* uses answered items , works missing responses; infit outfit PCM take number categories item parameters respect slopes GPCM; jackknife SE lz uses person-specific priors. Results longer rounded (p values 0.0004 shown 0). Scalar mu, sigma2 item parameters recycled persons items. key detecting duplicated response patterns , rare cases, treat different patterns equal. option killdupli gone (see Deprecated). Numerically stable item probabilities (overflow 4PL, log-sum-exp GPCM), also sim_4pl() sim_gpcm().

title: PP 1.0.0
text: PV() needs estimate prior, .e. type = "eap" "map"; stops MLE, WLE robust estimates. prior : mu sigma2 given ignored warning stored NA. Persons whose estimating equation root inside range (new argument, default c(-6, 6)) get bound status "boundary" warning (: NaN drifting values). Persons without response get NA (: +Inf); EAP prior mean SD. results numbered person order response matrix; row names respm carried (use person variable PPass() ids). PPass() eRm objects: method PPass.Rm replaced PPass.eRm, result PPass() data.frame class ppass new column status. type = "eap" "robust" contains estimates (message). sim_4pl() sim_gpcm() draw differently, simulated data identical 0.6.4-1 seed. Pfit() now gives lz lz* models (lz* Sinharay, 2016, correction estimation type), summary() result replaces printed summary. Pfit() takes item parameters estimation object. element $ipar estimation objects (processed input 0.6.4 layout) longer part result; estimates $estimates. JKpp(maxsteps, exac) default values estimation object (500 0.001). Pfit(pp, fitindices, SE): argument respm removed, responses come estimation object. Use Pfit(res) instead Pfit(respm = X, pp = res). estimation objects 0.6.4-1 contain rows persons extreme score (MLE) duplicated patterns, responses passed ; new objects one row per person.
